name: Maids of Honor
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: juice and rind of one lemon
ingredients.originalText: juice and rind of one lemon

ingredients.name: small cupful of white pounded sugar
ingredients.originalText: a small cupful of white pounded sugar

instructions.text: Put both kinds of milk together in a vessel, which is set in another and let it become sufficiently heated to set the curd
strain off the milk, rub the curd through a strainer
add butter to the curd, the sugar, well-beaten eggs and lemon
Line the little pans with the richest of puff paste and fill with the mixture
bake until firm in the centre, from ten to fifteen minutes

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put both kinds of milk together in a vessel, which is set in another and let it become sufficiently heated to set the curd
2. strain off the milk, rub the curd through a strainer
3. add butter to the curd, the sugar, well-beaten eggs and lemon
4. Line the little pans with the richest of puff paste and fill with the mixture
5. bake until firm in the centre, from ten to fifteen minutes
